factual_claims.claim: Seven established AI companies including Google and Meta account for more than 35% of the entire S&P 500.
The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI) found that AI companies scored an average of 40 out of 100 on transparency.
Meta's transparency score dropped from 60 in 2024 to 31 in 2025, and Mistral's score dropped from 55 to 18.
